governing_completion_principles: Phase 0 safety primitives are reused but do not define a global stop-on-UNKNOWN policy for this loop.
A successful task continues to next-task selection without asking the human.
UNKNOWN must be typed; transient/recoverable cases attempt bounded recovery.
Stale HEAD triggers readback/replan before campaign stop.
A blocked task is isolated while independent safe work continues.
Reversible choices with a safe default may be recorded as Deferred Decisions and continued.
Timeout triggers reconciliation/recovery before terminal classification.
Ambiguous side-effecting writes are never blindly replayed; readback first.
Corrective work is a new task, not a replay of an ambiguous write.
Round/retry/corrective/timeout limits are configurable; six rounds is not architectural.
Wake must restore and resume the authorized campaign, not merely report status.
Autonomous-loop completion requires multi-round, session-resuming evidence, not a one-shot wake.
next_safe_work: Introduce a backward-compatible campaign policy/config layer around the existing controller.
Add typed UNKNOWN/recovery semantics and blocker isolation.
Add Deferred Decision and next_safe_action durable state without blindly trusting cached state.
Add bounded read/test/evidence retry and stale-HEAD replan paths.
Connect Routine/event wake to controller resume under durable campaign authority.
Design safe automatic expired-owner reclaim for normal session loss.
Redesign same-HEAD evidence reinspection append-only without weakening legacy validators or bypassing classifiers.
Build multi-round STATIC/mock E2E including corrective, session restart, duplicate wake, stale HEAD and blocked-task continuation.
Only after STATIC proof, prepare explicit-authorized LIVE proof of at least three consecutive autonomous rounds.
